note: Mostly seasonal: about 54 of its 224 sites are sold by the night; the shore rows (The Point, Lakeside, Darlings' west row) are seasonal. Regional park strung along the east shore of spring-fed Lac Pelletier, about 50 km by road from Swift Current, with beaches, a boat launch, a nine-hole grass-greens golf course, a store and restaurant, and micro-chalets. Among the nightly sites only the Glade's back row (T12, T15, T16) looks across open lawn to the lake. --Claude
summary: Keep with the seasonal caveat. Accredited regional park, 224 sites; Let's Camp sells 54 RV sites by the night (24%), all others seasonal by lottery. 2-night minimum all season (under the 3-night rule). C$40-50 a night, entry C$15/day. Lakeview kept on the nightly Glade back row T12/T15/T16 (photos show the lake across open lawn, 70-100 m); every shore row is seasonal. Phone '' -> 306-627-3595. Google rating unverified (3.9/14 came from a results list).
flags: NIGHTLY SHARE: 54 of 224 (24%). The operator: 'Many campsites are seasonally rentals so book your daily campsite and early. When seasonal sites become available, they are assigned by a lottery system.' and 'All daily campsites are booked through the online line booking system.' Let's Camp sells exactly 54 RV sites (A1-A8, PC1/2/5/10/11, N1-4 + N19-26, T12/15/16, C1-C12, D11-13/23/26-28/45-47/50, M6-M8) plus 3 micro chalets. The wording urges booking early rather than discouraging nightly guests. Posted 2026 nightly and seasonal rates; a booking engine.

GOOGLE: the place-panel search landed on a results list; the first result read 3.9 stars (14 reviews) at '20 Maple Dr, Simmie' - probably a business inside the park, not the park itself. The park's own rating is unread.
MIN STAY: Let's Camp camp rules '2. Minimum 2 nights stay.' (all sites except D50 at 1 night) - a standing 2-night minimum, below the 3-night drop rule; written to booking.min_stay.

WATERFRONT: lakeview kept (stored, not --AWH), now resting on nightly sites. The Glade (south end) back row T11-T20 sits ~49.9659,-107.9291; T12, T15 and T16 are sold by the night and their Let's Camp photos show the lake across open lawn past the front row's sheds; Esri z17 puts the row 70-100 m from the water at Ona's Beach (49.9669,-107.9294), beyond the camp kitchen and playground lawn - a view, not frontage. Every row near the shore (The Point P1-P17, Lakeside L1-L15, Darlings D1-D9/D69 along the walking path) is seasonal: none is on Let's Camp. Other nightly rows' photos (Pioneer A, Pelican PC, Ona's N, Corral C) show prairie hills or trees, no water.
PIN: stored 49.96730,-107.92610 is between Pioneer and the Corral at the south end, where 40 of the 54 nightly sites are; keep.

SPLIT (not recommended): the park's camping lies in two clusters ~1.6 km apart along Maple Drive, each with a toll booth - North (The Point, Darlings, Meadows: ~90 sites, ~49.984,-107.927, nightly D and M sites) and South (Pioneer, Corral, Lakeside, Glade, Ona's, Gull Lake, Pelican: ~114 sites, ~49.9670,-107.9280), with Hidden Valley (23) between. One park, one office, one Let's Camp booking (https://letscamp.ca/camps/lac-pelletier) and one entry pass; the north centroid is approximate (imagery, not a site plan).
